verdict.line: You lose if you stand and trade into level 6-8 Ignite all-ins; you win if you poke and disengage to scaling items.

brief.thesis: Garen's kit has no mana cost and his passive Perseverance regenerates a percentage of his health whenever he hasn't taken damage recently, so short all-ins just heal him back up. Riven's only way to win the lane is to hit-and-run with Q (Broken Wings) into immediate E (Valor) resets rather than standing in extended trades where his W (Courage) and passive sustain outlast her. The 45.7% win rate over 947 games and Garen's solo-kill advantage confirm this is a lane you survive early and win with items, not one you win with early kill pressure.

theirWindow.when: Q, W, and E all off cooldown near you
theirWindow.what: He can burst his move speed with Q (Decisive Strike) to close the gap, silence and bonus-damage you on the next auto, hold W (Courage) for sustained damage, and spin E (Judgment) on top. If your own E (Valor) is down when this lines up, disengage instead of trading.

yourWindow.when: right after his Q (Decisive Strike) is used or whiffs
yourWindow.what: With the silence and move-speed burst gone for 8 seconds, he can't punish or escape a real trade. Stun with W (Ki Burst) and chain into Q (Broken Wings) charges while it's down.

start.why: The 90% pick rate at 45.7% win rate reflects the standard answer to a lane where you need sustain through poke rather than a burst item you can't use safely yet.

boots.why: Highest win rate of the boot options (47.3%); the ability haste shortens Q/W/E cooldowns so you can poke-and-reset more often against a champion who punishes standing still.

core.why: Anchors the highest-winrate core path (63.2% over 95 games) and gives the cooldown/mobility to keep disengaging.
Sustain and scaling damage to survive the poke phase before your kit fully comes online.
Damage-to-heal conversion directly counters Garen's Perseverance sustain race in extended skirmishes.

runes.keystoneWhy: Stacks through extended skirmishes and grants adaptive healing, directly offsetting Garen's Perseverance regen once a fight goes long enough for you to win it.

summoners.why: The overwhelming pick (93.8%) for this matchup; Ignite gives you kill pressure and grievous wounds to blunt his passive regen when he overextends a trade.

playing.title: Poke, don't stand and trade
playing.detail: Hit with Q (Broken Wings) and step out with E (Valor) instead of holding an extended trade. Garen's Perseverance heals him back the moment he stops taking damage, so sustained contact favors him.

playing.title: Track his Q (Decisive Strike) cooldown
playing.detail: It's an 8-second cooldown. Once he's used it and the silence/move-speed burst is gone, you can trade freely without fear of a follow-up lockdown.

playing.title: Respect the level 6-8 all-in
playing.detail: Once he hits 6, Demacian Justice paired with Ignite threatens an execute. Play for pokes, not all-ins, until you have E (Valor) ready to absorb his engage.

playing.title: Save E (Valor) for his engage, not pre-emptively
playing.detail: Valor blocks incoming damage during the dash. Hold it to step through his Q auto or E (Judgment) spin rather than burning it early.

playing.title: Build Runic Blade charges before committing
playing.detail: Charge your blade with Q/W/E so your empowered autos carry the trade. He has no ranged tool to interrupt your setup.

playing.title: Full-combo only after his E (Judgment) is down
playing.detail: Judgment is his main sustained damage on a 13/12/11/10/9s cooldown. Commit your Q-W-E string right after he uses it, not before.

playing.title: Play for scaling, not lane kills
playing.detail: With Garen favored for solo kills, avoid forcing all-ins early. Use Q's mobility to win tempo and rotate, and bank on your Death's Dance/Axiom Arc spike to flip 1v1s from level 9 onward.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, and win rates are pulled from measured games on the current patch (947 Riven vs Garen games); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are our own tactical read.

stats.opponentTip: Use your abilities to attack and fall back periodically to prevent Garen from activating his passive ability. Be careful when Garen reaches level 6 and has Ignite.
